input: app.use('/ftp', serveIndexMiddleware, serveIndex('ftp', { icons: true })) // vuln-code-snippet vuln-line directoryListingChallenge

context.guidance: Require authentication on every route that returns Personal Data, and check on each request that the authenticated Data Principal owns the record or holds a role authorised for it. Do not let an identifier supplied in the path or body decide ownership. Apply the check to every method on the route, because Rule 6(1)(b) requires access to the resources holding Personal Data to be controlled.

value.fix: Don't expose '/ftp' as a public directory listing. Remove serveIndex('ftp', { icons: true }) so the folder contents can't be browsed. If the files still need to be served, put the route behind authentication and authorization middleware that runs on every HTTP method (app.use('/ftp', security.isAuthorized(), requireRole(['admin']), ...)). Serve only an explicit allowlist of non-sensitive files. Decide access from the authenticated session or token and the user's role or ownership, never from the filename or path in the request. Return 403 or 404 for anything not allowlisted. Move backups, order exports, coupon files and any other files holding Personal Data out of the web-served 'ftp' directory into access-controlled storage. Return each file only after checking on that request that the caller owns it or holds an authorized role, as Rule 6(1)(b) requires.
